proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2389 uṣṇa gives Pali/Prakrit uṇha, Gujarati ūnũ/hunũ and Marathi ūnh/ūn “hot”. Loss of the cluster aspiration supplies the western n-bearing outcomes; the phonology is distinct from unrelated tāta and garam forms.
